answer: A sybil farm gains nothing from many keys if influence is gated by a governance threshold: a proposal passes only when support exceeds a fraction q of total standing, so flooding the river of fake votes cannot raise q without also raising the denominator it must beat. Each fake identity must also cross a pulse of activity history, and like a yarrow stem that must root before it branches, a fresh key vote counts only after real work. The farmer marginal vote is diluted by every honest key it cannot remove.
